## Kimi K3.1 Pro API

Kimi K3.1 Pro is a large language model by Moonshot AI, available on the Venice API as `kimi-k3-1-pro`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot AI's flagship multimodal reasoning model and the post-trained successor to Kimi K3, with a 1M-token context window. It is built for long-horizon coding, agentic workflows, financial research, and 3D modeling through CAD code.

### Kimi K3.1 Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kimi-k3-1-pro` | Standard | Private | $2.00 / $10.00 per 1M |

### Kimi K3.1 Pro specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Moonshot AI |
| Released | Oct 23, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Censorship | Censored |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, low, high, max |

### How to use the Kimi K3.1 Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "kimi-k3-1-pro"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "kimi-k3-1-pro",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "max"
  }'
```

### Kimi K3.1 Pro API FAQ

#### How much does the Kimi K3.1 Pro API cost?

$2.00 per 1M input tokens and $10.00 per 1M output tokens, with cached input at $0.20 per 1M. Prices are in USD and can be paid in DIEM at parity.

#### What is the Kimi K3.1 Pro model ID?

Use `kimi-k3-1-pro` as the `model` parameter.

#### Is the Kimi K3.1 Pro API private?

Kimi K3.1 Pro is private. Zero data retention, enforced by contract. Prompts and outputs are processed for inference only and not retained after the request completes.

#### What is the context window of Kimi K3.1 Pro?

1M tokens of context, with up to 128K output tokens per response.

#### What does Kimi K3.1 Pro support?

Kimi K3.1 Pro supports function calling, structured outputs, reasoning, image input, web search and prompt caching. Reasoning effort is adjustable with `reasoning_effort`: none, low, high and max (default max).

#### Which endpoint does the Kimi K3.1 Pro API use?

Call `POST /chat/completions`. `/responses` (Alpha) is also supported.
